shortTitle: AASM Central Disorders of Hypersomnolence Treatment Guideline
citation: Maski K, Trotti LM, Kotagal S, et al. Treatment of central disorders of hypersomnolence: an American Academy of Sleep Medicine clinical practice guideline. J Clin Sleep Med. 2021;17(9):1881-1893.
currencyNote: This guideline updates earlier AASM treatment practice parameters for narcolepsy and other hypersomnias of central origin and was verified from the Guild Drive copy on 2026-08-07.
bestFor: Current treatment concepts for narcolepsy, idiopathic hypersomnia, Kleine-Levin syndrome, hypersomnia due to medical conditions, and pediatric narcolepsy after diagnosis has been established.

mappingRationale.D1A: Supports current disease/treatment context for central disorders of hypersomnolence during clinical assessment and disorder recognition. It is not an MSLT/MWT procedure source.

authorityBoundary: Use ICSD-3-TR for diagnostic classification and the current AASM adult/pediatric MSLT protocols for daytime-testing procedures. This guideline addresses treatment, not diagnostic-test performance or scoring.
copyrightUse: Use citation, public section headings, original summaries, and learning objectives. Do not reproduce substantial recommendation wording, evidence tables, or protected passages.

sections.label: Guideline scope and update of prior hypersomnia treatment parameters
